verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's own docs describe live audio handled over a WebSocket at about 150ms p50 latency. They also describe a Universal Streaming page where the SDK manages the WebSocket connection and session termination, plus Python/TypeScript SDK support for streaming. The 2018 community remark that it 'needs real-time dictation' is an old feature request, not a hands-on failure of the current streaming capability, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live streaming, and documented WebSocket endpoint/message-protocol details in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: Handles live audio over WebSocket with ~150ms p50 latency, powering voice agents, live captions, and real-time agent-assist tools in contact centers.
The AssemblyAI SDK manages the WebSocket connection and session termination for you.
Use the Python or TypeScript SDK to integrate transcription, streaming, and voice agents directly into your own codebase.
